BETA
Core commands use the deterministic catalogue and Vite/React export. The linter, ingestion, resource scaffolder and contribution gate are Beta and have not completed black-box hardening.
← Back to Documentation
Tessellate CLI (`tess`)

The official command-line interface for installing, validating, and exporting Tessellate components.

Installation
pnpm add -g @tessellate/cli
# Or run with npx:
npx @tessellate/cli --help
Commands
tess add <slug>

Resolves and writes component source code into your project directory.

tess add metric-card
tess add ai-chat-panel --overwrite
tess search [query]

Search the 324-resource open catalogue directly from your terminal.

tess search "fintech"
tess search --category "data"
tess validate [path]

Validates a local ResourceManifest or ProjectManifest against canonical Zod schemas.

tess validate ./resources/my-card/manifest.json
tess export [project-file]

Generates a standalone Vite + React + Tailwind project from a ProjectManifest. Next.js and native targets are not selected by this CLI command.

tess export project.tess.json --output ./my-app
